questions.answer: In an era when people live longer, dementia has been recognized as one of the biggest challenges many households have to cope with.

At a time when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been considered one of the biggest challenges that many families have to deal with.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（provided by the government）

1.explanation_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」是修飾「時代」的子句，英文放在名詞後面，用關係副詞 when：In an era when people live longer（越活越長也可寫 are living longer and longer）。「已被視為」是完成式被動 has been regarded as；「…最大挑戰之一」是 one of the biggest challenges，後面接省略關代的子句 many households have to cope with（cope with 的 with 不能省）。
evidence: 在人們越活越長的時代
1.strategy_zh: 「在…的時代」先寫 In an age／era，再用 when 接子句；「已被…」用 has been + p.p.；「…之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞。
hints: 切成四段：在人們越活越長的時代／失智症（dementia）已被視為／許多家庭必須面對的／最大挑戰之一
標的詞彙：age（時代）、people（人們）、live（活）、long（長的）、regard（視為）、family（家庭）、face（面對）、big（大的）、challenge（挑戰）
句型框架：In an era when + S + V …, S + has been regarded as one of the + 最高級 + N + (that) + S + have to + V.

2.explanation_zh: 「許多家庭都無法確定，是否該…」用間接問句：Many families cannot decide (are not sure) whether they should …（或 whether to …），whether 後面用直述句語序。「申請」是 apply for + N。「由政府提供的長照服務」修飾語在名詞前，英文用過去分詞片語放在名詞後面：long-term care services provided by the government（服務是被提供的，用 p.p.）。「來照顧失智的長輩」用不定詞表目的 to look after elderly relatives with dementia，「失智的」用 with dementia 放在名詞後面。
evidence: 由政府提供的長照服務
2.strategy_zh: 「無法確定是否…」用 cannot decide／be not sure + whether + S + should …；看到「由…＋動詞＋的＋名詞」，先想「名詞＋過去分詞＋by …」的後位修飾。
hints: 切成四段：許多家庭都無法確定／是否該申請／由政府提供的長照服務／來照顧失智（dementia）的長輩
標的詞彙：family（家庭）、sure（確定的）、whether（是否）、apply（申請）、provide（提供）、government（政府）、care（照顧）、service（服務）、elderly（年長的）
句型框架：S + cannot decide (are not sure) + whether + S + should apply for + N + p.p. + by … + to VR …

traps.literal_error: In the people-living-longer-and-longer era, dementia has been regarded as …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「…的時代」修飾語在前，英文要改成 an age when + 子句，放在名詞後面。

bonus.text: As people live ever longer, dementia has come to be seen as one of the toughest challenges confronting families.
bonus.explanation_zh: ever longer（越來越長）、has come to be seen as（漸漸被視為）、confronting families（家庭所面臨的）是進階寫法；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」修飾語在前，英文改成關係副詞子句 In an era when people live longer；「許多家庭必須面對的最大挑戰之一」改成 one of the biggest challenges (that) many households have to cope with（face）。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「在人們越活越長的時代」In an age／era（At a time、In this era）＋when（in which）＋people live longer (and longer)、people are living longer (and longer、than ever)，In an age where … 也給分。第 2 部分「失智症已被視為」dementia has (already) been＋regarded as／seen as／considered (to be)／viewed as／recognized as（完成式被動），has come to be seen as、is now regarded as 也給分。第 3 部分「許多家庭必須面對的」(that／which) many families（households）＋have to／must／need to＋face／deal with／cope with／confront，關代可以省略；「必須」要譯出來。第 4 部分「最大挑戰之一」one of the biggest／greatest／most serious／toughest challenges（最高級＋複數名詞）。

common_errors.wrong: to take care their elderly relatives with dementia
common_errors.right: to take care of their elderly relatives with dementia
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「照顧」是 take care of（或 care for、look after），介系詞不能省。

common_errors.wrong: to care their elderly relatives with dementia
common_errors.right: to care for their elderly relatives with dementia
common_errors.explanation_zh: care 當「照顧」時要接 for：care for sb。

traps.literal_error: Many families cannot decide whether they should apply long-term care services provided by the government to look after elderly relatives with dementia.
traps.explanation_zh: 「申請某物」是 apply for + N；apply 直接接受詞是「應用、塗抹」，意思不對。

traps.zh: 由政府提供的長照服務
traps.literal_error: Many families cannot decide whether they should apply for the government provides long-term care services to look after elderly relatives with dementia.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「由政府提供的」放在名詞前；英文要改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：long-term care services provided by the government，不能把「政府提供」寫成一個子句塞在名詞前面。

bonus.text: Many families are torn over whether to entrust their elderly relatives with dementia to long-term care services provided by the government.
bonus.explanation_zh: be torn over whether …（為是否…而左右為難）、entrust A to B（把 A 託付給 B）是進階寫法；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「由政府提供的長照服務」中文的修飾語在名詞前，英文改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：long-term care services provided by the government；「是否該…」改成間接問句 whether + 主詞 + should …（直述句語序）。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「許多家庭都無法確定」Many families（households）＋cannot decide／are not sure／cannot be sure／are unsure／are uncertain／do not know。第 2 部分「是否該申請」whether they should apply for、whether to apply for、if they should apply for（whether or not … 也可以）；間接問句用直述句語序，apply for 的 for 不能省。第 3 部分「由政府提供的長照服務」(the) long-term care services provided (offered) by the government；寫成完整的關係子句 that the government provides、that are provided by the government 也算後位修飾，給分；service 用單數或寫 long-term care 時，關係子句用 is provided。第 4 部分「來照顧失智的長輩」to look after／take care of／care for＋(their) elderly relatives（elderly family members、elderly parents、older relatives、aging parents、elders；不加 their 時也可寫 the elderly、elderly people）＋with dementia（who have dementia、suffering from dementia、who suffer from dementia）；長照服務本身就是照顧，寫成 for (their) elderly relatives with dementia 也給分。

1.translation: In an age when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been regarded as one of the greatest challenges that many families must face.
1.explanation_zh: 「在……的時代」用 In an age when + 子句（關係副詞 when）；「越活越長」用 比較級 and 比較級 longer and longer，配現在進行式表趨勢；「已被視為」用現在完成式被動 has been regarded as；「最大挑戰之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數；「必須面對的」用 that many families must face。

2.translation: Many families are not sure whether they should apply for the long-term care services provided by the government to take care of their elderly family members with dementia.
2.explanation_zh: 「無法確定是否該……」用 be not sure whether + 主詞 should（也可 whether to V）；「由政府提供的長照服務」用過去分詞後位修飾 provided by the government；「來照顧」用不定詞表目的 to take care of；「失智的長輩」譯 elderly family members with dementia。

1.translation: In an era when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been regarded as one of the biggest challenges that many families have to face.
1.explanation_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」用 In an era when ... 加現在進行式 are living longer and longer；「已被視為」用現在完成式被動 has been regarded as；「最大挑戰之一」用 one of the biggest challenges；「必須面對的」用 that many families have to face 關係子句。

2.translation: Many families are unsure whether they should apply for the long-term care services provided by the government to look after elderly family members with dementia.
2.explanation_zh: 「無法確定，是否該…」用 are unsure whether they should V；「由政府提供的長照服務」用 long-term care services provided by the government；「來照顧失智的長輩」用不定詞表目的 to look after elderly family members with dementia。「長輩」可譯成 elders 或 elderly family members，「長照」的標準譯法是 long-term care，所以信心 medium。
